user.title: Pick your Towngas branch
user.description: Select the Towngas branch shown in your billing URL, for example .../business/pay/owe/ZS0105/16XXXXX.

oauth.title: WeChat authorization

account.title: Account details and authCode
account.description:
**authCode**: the value after `authCode=` in the redirect URL from the previous step (valid for about 5 minutes).

**subsCode**: the last part of the billing URL, for example 1700075442 in .../ZS0105/**1700075442**.

**subsId**: a 32 character account id. To get it, log in at https://www.towngasvcc.com/?login=true (phone number + SMS code) and open https://www.towngasvcc.com/user/querySubsList — the `subsId` field in the returned JSON.

{error_detail}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize (1/2): scan with WeChat
reauth_confirm.description:
The session for subscriber {subs_code} has expired.

Scan the QR code below with **WeChat on your phone**; after authorizing, the page redirects to `{oauth_redirect}`. Copy the authCode into the next step.

{oauth_qr_markdown}

If the QR code does not render, open this URL with WeChat on your phone:
`{oauth_url}`

reauth_token.title: Re-authorize (2/2): authCode
reauth_token.description:
Paste the value after `authCode=` from the redirect URL.

{oauth_qr_markdown}

error.invalid_org: The selected branch was not found, please pick again
error.auth_failed: Authorization failed: the authCode is invalid or expired (about 5 minutes), please scan again

abort.no_orgs: Bundled branch list (orglist.json) could not be loaded, please reinstall the integration
abort.already_configured: This subscriber number is already configured for this branch
abort.oauth_url_failed: Could not fetch the WeChat authorization URL, check the network and retry
